status.en: 25 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 150% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah and Erbil.
status.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 150 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces have moved into the militia-held town of Jurf al-Sakhar, deploying Brigade 72 and seizing checkpoints as Kataib Hezbollah begins a phased withdrawal. A power-station explosion in southern Iraq killed at least four people, and Iraqi police arrested officers and suspects linked to oil-pipeline smuggling between Dhi Qar and Basra. Senior ISIS figures were killed in operations in Diyala and northeastern Iraq, while a new Shiite militia, Asa'ib Al-Jihad, announced its formation. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
